`LeastEmbedding.embedding` constructs `BridgeReview.MinimalEmbedding` from an
actual tree `t : RMAF.Tree`, a selection `S`, and witnesses `x ∈ leaves t` and `x ∈ S`.
Its support list is exactly `RMAF.minimalVertices S t`. Its ambient and terminal
lists have proved interpretations as actual vertex addresses and selected leaf
occurrences. Ambient inclusion, terminal preservation and leastness are proved;
none is a constructor argument. The author audit kernel-checks this interface.
The independent semantic verdict is recorded separately in `acceptance.json`
and the fresh review receipts.

The unchanged source is `research/rmaf/lean/RMAF.lean`, SHA256
`4960d5be9a5f1eb6b15d11c76130bee5263125631314a4eb2d43d500d5b513a9`.
The result is about this ordered binary tree and address model. It does not
supply cross-tree restriction/suppression transport, G2–G7, the full exchange
construction, a safe-cover theorem, an unrestricted runtime bound or novelty.

- membership in `vertices t` is equivalent to `ValidVertex t v`;
- membership in `terminals S t` is equivalent to an actual leaf occurrence at
  that address with a label in S;
- a label belongs to `leaves t` exactly when it has a leaf occurrence;
- two leaf occurrences at the same address have the same label; each label
  occurring in `leaves t` has exactly one address when `leaves t` has no
  repeated labels;
- each permutation field of `RMAF.Instance` supplies this uniqueness for
  every label below `Instance.n`, and excludes other labels.

Arbitrary repeated-label trees are included in the constructor theorem. Selecting
such a label selects every occurrence. Repeated entries in the selection do not
repeat terminal addresses. `vertices_nodup` and `terminals_nodup` are proved for
all trees and selections. Empty or entirely absent selections have empty output
and do not satisfy the constructor's explicit occurring-selected-label premise.
A selected singleton-root leaf is included.

Imported old declarations and independent finite-panel equalities are outside

The nine frozen fixtures cover crossing quartet leaves, a singleton, siblings,
empty and absent selection, a singleton-root tree, repeated labels, repeated

They also prove failure of path deletion, invalid ambient address and missing

def embedding (selected : List Nat) (t : Tree) (x : Nat)
    (hx : x ∈ leaves t) (hs : x ∈ selected) : MinimalEmbedding where
  ambient := vertices t
  terminals := terminals selected t
  terminal_nonempty := terminal_nonempty hx hs
  support := extractedSupport selected t (minimalVertices_nonempty_of_leaf selected t x hx hs)
  inAmbient := by
    intro v hv
    exact minimal_in_vertices selected t v (by simpa only [extractedSupport_exact] using hv)
  containsTerminals := by
    intro v hv
    simpa only [extractedSupport_exact] using terminals_in_minimal selected t v hv
  minimal := by
    intro other _ hterm v hv
    exact minimal_least selected t other hterm v (by simpa only [extractedSupport_exact] using hv)

theorem embedding_consumer (sa sb : List Nat) (ta tb : Tree) (xa xb : Nat)
    (hxa : xa ∈ leaves ta) (hsa : xa ∈ sa) (hxb : xb ∈ leaves tb) (hsb : xb ∈ sb)
    (hdepth : (embedding sb tb xb hxb hsb).support.root.length ≤
      (embedding sa ta xa hxa hsa).support.root.length)
    (hoverlap : ∃ v, v ∈ minimalVertices sa ta ∧ v ∈ minimalVertices sb tb) :
    (embedding sa ta xa hxa hsa).support.root ∈ minimalVertices sb tb := by
  have h := MinimalEmbedding.deepest_root_in_neighbor
    (embedding sa ta xa hxa hsa) (embedding sb tb xb hxb hsb) hdepth
    (by simpa only [embedding_support_exact] using hoverlap)
  simpa only [embedding_support_exact] using h

theorem minimal_least (selected : List Nat) (t : Tree) (other : ConnectedSupport)
    (hterm : ∀ p, p ∈ terminals selected t → p ∈ other.first :: other.rest)
    (v : Vertex) (hv : v ∈ minimalVertices selected t) :
    v ∈ other.first :: other.rest := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hvp⟩ := minimal_terminal_descendant selected t v hv
  have hav : other.root.IsPrefix v := minimal_below_common_ancestor selected t other.root
    (fun q hq => other.toRootedRegion.below q (hterm q hq)) v hv
  exact other.toRootedRegion.convex v p hav hvp (hterm p hp)

theorem LeafOccurrence.label_unique {t : Tree} {v : Vertex} {x y : Nat}
    (hx : LeafOccurrence t v x) (hy : LeafOccurrence t v y) : x = y := by
  induction hx generalizing y with
  | leaf x => cases hy; rfl
  | left hx ih => cases hy with | left hy => exact ih hy
  | right hx ih => cases hy with | right hy => exact ih hy

theorem unique_occurrence_of_nodup {t : Tree} {x : Nat}
    (hn : (leaves t).Nodup) (hx : x ∈ leaves t) :
    ∃ v, LeafOccurrence t v x ∧ ∀ w, LeafOccurrence t w x → w = v := by
  rcases mem_leaves_iff_occurrence.mp hx with ⟨v, hv⟩
  exact ⟨v, hv, fun _ hw => hw.address_unique hn hv⟩

theorem instance_left_nodup (i : Instance) : (leaves i.left).Nodup :=
  i.labels_left.nodup_iff.mpr List.nodup_range

theorem instance_right_nodup (i : Instance) : (leaves i.right).Nodup :=
  i.labels_right.nodup_iff.mpr List.nodup_range

theorem instance_left_mem_leaves_iff (i : Instance) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ leaves i.left ↔ x < i.n :=
  i.labels_left.mem_iff.trans List.mem_range

theorem instance_right_mem_leaves_iff (i : Instance) (x : Nat) :
    x ∈ leaves i.right ↔ x < i.n :=
  i.labels_right.mem_iff.trans List.mem_range

theorem instance_left_unique_occurrence (i : Instance) {x : Nat} (hx : x < i.n) :
    ∃ v, LeafOccurrence i.left v x ∧ ∀ w, LeafOccurrence i.left w x → w = v :=
  unique_occurrence_of_nodup (instance_left_nodup i)
    ((instance_left_mem_leaves_iff i x).mpr hx)

theorem instance_right_unique_occurrence (i : Instance) {x : Nat} (hx : x < i.n) :
    ∃ v, LeafOccurrence i.right v x ∧ ∀ w, LeafOccurrence i.right w x → w = v :=
  unique_occurrence_of_nodup (instance_right_nodup i)
    ((instance_right_mem_leaves_iff i x).mpr hx)

theorem instance_left_occurrence_iff (i : Instance) (x : Nat) :
    (∃ v, LeafOccurrence i.left v x) ↔ x < i.n :=
  mem_leaves_iff_occurrence.symm.trans (instance_left_mem_leaves_iff i x)

theorem instance_right_occurrence_iff (i : Instance) (x : Nat) :
    (∃ v, LeafOccurrence i.right v x) ↔ x < i.n :=
  mem_leaves_iff_occurrence.symm.trans (instance_right_mem_leaves_iff i x)

`LeastEmbedding.minimal_least` itself uses `ConnectedSupport.toRootedRegion`
at its final proof lines: `below` makes the competitor root a common ancestor
of all selected terminals, and `convex` forces the given emitted vertex between
that root and its terminal descendant. Both hypotheses are explicit in the
proof. This use requires no leastness of the competitor and no assumed hull
identity. Therefore it is not circular through the MinimalEmbedding field that
is being constructed.
